prompt: A hyper-realistic cinematic photograph of a hiker wearing a dark fabric blindfold, standing on a complex, undulating mountain slope shrouded in dense, heavy fog. Extreme detail on the contact point between the boot and the earth.
metaphor: Clear fall-line descent down a steep slope like gradient descent so hiker blindfolded. probing foot calculates slope & braking on a descent. Learning rate: larger steps on steeper regions, smaller steps as it flattens
